description: NUPACK 4 invocation used by ACCORD. Every call is nupack.mfe(strands=[seq], model=nupack.Model(...)) on a single strand; ties among co-optimal MFE structures are broken by taking the lexicographically smallest dot-bracket string. 'canonical' is the only primary configuration; the others are sensitivity arms and are reported under their own names.

canonical.notes: Package-default RNA parameters at 37 C, 1 M Na+, no Mg2+.

wc_only.notes: Canonical parameters; pairs that are not Watson-Crick or GU are removed from both the prediction and the reference before scoring.
